gloss_en: Which IFC versions are used in Norwegian projects and what does IFC4.3 add?
question_paraphrase: hvilke IFC-versjoner brukes i prosjekter nå, og hva er nytt i IFC4.3?
phrasing_notes: Glossary style; Norwegian terms mixed with IFC2x3/IFC4/IFC4.3, IFC-SPF, ifcXML
answer_summary: IFC is NS-EN ISO 16739; projects use IFC2x3, IFC4 and IFC4.3; 4.3 adds bridges, roads, rail, waterways, harbours and coordinate transformation; 4.4 will add tunnels; IFC5 planned.

gloss_en: What is POFIN and can I use it to set openBIM requirements in a contract?
question_paraphrase: hva er POFIN og kan vi bruke det til å stille krav til informasjonsleveranser?
answer_summary: POFIN 1.0 is a modular national framework from buildingSMART Norge: 14 documents and 2 spreadsheets with predefined information requirements, supporting requirement setting, contracts, CDE setup, follow-up and FDV use.

gloss_en: Guide to IFC for beginners and advanced users, aimed at writing requirements and checking deliveries
question_paraphrase: finnes det en veileder som forklarer IFC-struktur og vanlige problemer, til bruk ved kravsetting og kontroll av leveranser?
answer_summary: buildingSMART Norge publishes a Norwegian and English guide covering what IFC is, its structure and common issues.

gloss_en: Guidelines for detailed VA (water and wastewater) models based on IFC 4.3, made with Oslo VAV
question_paraphrase: hvordan skal kummer, rør og rørdeler modelleres i IFC 4.3 for VA?
phrasing_notes: VA = vann og avløp; kum, rør
answer_summary: Industry guidelines for manholes, pipes and fittings: model structure, information and geometry requirements, based on IFC 4.3.

gloss_en: Reinforcement guide 2.0 on ordering and producing rebar digitally from open-standard models
question_paraphrase: hvordan går vi fra armeringsmodell til bestilling og produksjon med åpne standarder?
answer_summary: Rebar working group guide mapping current practice and goals for digital ordering and production of reinforcement from open models.

gloss_en: openBIM Harmony: guidelines, templates and predefined info requirements based on ISO 19650 and CEN/TR 17654
question_paraphrase: hva er openBIM Harmony og hvordan henger det sammen med POFIN?
phrasing_notes: Mixed English product name in Norwegian text
answer_summary: A framework for specifying and following up information deliveries; POFIN is built on it.

gloss_en: MMI-veilederen 2.0: model maturity index harmonised for building and infrastructure by Statsbygg, Nye Veier, Bane NOR, Statens vegvesen
question_paraphrase: hvilken MMI-kode skal objektene ha i modellen ved hver milepæl?
answer_summary: Shared numeric maturity coding for model objects, for Bygg and Samferdsel; contributors include EBA, MEF, RIF, Statens vegvesen, Nye Veier, Bane NOR, Statsbygg; buildingSMART Norge maintains it from 2026.

gloss_en: Which Norwegian standardisation committees govern BIM and classification?
question_paraphrase: hvilke komiteer i Standard Norge styrer BIM-standarder og klassifisering?
answer_summary: SN/K 257 BIM (mirror for CEN/ISO), SN/K 380 BIM objects, SN/K 518 classification, SN/K 285 FDVU, SN/K 401 NS 3420; participation in CEN TC442 WG2/4/11/12.

gloss_en: Supplier page of Nye Veier: tenders via Doffin and Artifik, delivery through total contractors; no BIM/IFC rules stated
question_paraphrase: hvor finner jeg Nye Veiers krav til digitale leveranser?
phrasing_notes: Shows BIM requirements live in tender documents, not on the public page
answer_summary: Page covers EHF invoicing, Doffin/Artifik, ISO certifications and 30% climate weighting; BIM/IFC requirements must be found in the tender documents.

gloss_en: BIMpraten podcast from Standard Norge and buildingSMART Norge
question_paraphrase: finnes det norsk podcast om BIM og standarder?
answer_summary: Podcast with bonus episodes e.g. openBIM Harmony, CEN/TC 442 report, Nordic collaboration.

gloss_en: Short Norwegian definitions of IDS, BCF, bSDD and openCDE
title_original: Kort forklart - IDS, BCF, bSDD, openCDE
question_paraphrase: hva er forskjellen på IDS, BCF og bSDD?
answer_summary: IDS machine-readable requirements for automated checks; BCF issue communication; bSDD dictionaries; openCDE APIs between CDEs.

gloss_en: NS 8360 concepts: LOD, custom property sets, process status codes, IsProcured, Milestone, DuplicateOwnedBy
question_paraphrase: hvilke egenskaper krever NS 8360 i modellen, f.eks. Milestone og IsProcured?
phrasing_notes: Property names in English inside Norwegian
answer_summary: NS 8360 defines process-information property sets and status codes used to mark object maturity and procurement.

gloss_en: Infrastructure domain forum for roads, rail and VA at buildingSMART Norge
question_paraphrase: finnes det et fagmiljo for IFC i veg og bane?
answer_summary: A forum for planning, building, operating infrastructure incl. road, rail, VA; working groups VA and Armering.

gloss_en: Check which objects lack an MMI value and list them by discipline
prompt: sjekk hvilke objekter som mangler MMI i modellen, grupper per fag og gi meg antall
expected_behavior: Scan property sets for an MMI property, list elements missing or empty, group by discipline/classification, report counts.

gloss_en: Why did so many elements come out as proxy and from which categories
prompt: hvorfor er det så mange IfcBuildingElementProxy her?? hvilke kategorier fra Revit kommer de fra
expected_behavior: Count proxies, group by Revit category/ObjectType, suggest IfcExportAs fixes.

gloss_en: Validate the model against the property requirements from the client's EIR
prompt: kan du kontrollere modellen mot kravene i EIR-en, spesielt at alle vegger har brannklasse og lastbærende
expected_behavior: Check walls for fire rating and LoadBearing in Pset_WallCommon, report failures with GUIDs.

gloss_en: Storeys appear duplicated after IFC export
prompt: etasjene blir dobbelt i IFC etter eksport fra Revit, noen ide? sjekk modellen
expected_behavior: List IfcBuildingStorey entries with elevations, detect duplicates/mismatched names, explain level export settings.

gloss_en: Is the road alignment georeferenced in EUREF89 NTM and what is the offset?
prompt: ligger veimodellen i riktig koordinatsystem (EUREF89 NTM sone?) Hva er origo og rotasjon
expected_behavior: Read IfcMapConversion/IfcProjectedCRS, report EPSG, eastings/northings, rotation; flag missing georeferencing.

gloss_en: Do all technical equipment items have FDV data and a TFM/NS 3451 code?
prompt: har alle tekniske komponenter FDV-info og NS 3451-kode? vil ha liste over de som mangler
expected_behavior: Check equipment for classification reference and maintenance properties, list gaps.

gloss_en: List ventilation systems and the number of ducts per system
prompt: list opp alle ventilasjonssystemer og antall kanaler i hvert system
expected_behavior: Query IfcSystem/IfcDistributionSystem and assigned duct segments, count per system.

gloss_en: Total net area of external walls per floor
prompt: trenger mengder: netto areal yttervegger per etasje, uten åpninger
expected_behavior: Sum NetSideArea from Qto_WallBaseQuantities for external walls grouped by storey; note missing quantities.

gloss_en: What changed between the last two RIB model versions
prompt: hva har endret seg i RIB-modellen siden forrige revisjon? trenger før møtet i morgen
expected_behavior: Compare two files by GlobalId, report added/removed/modified elements and key property changes.

gloss_en: Find clashes between ventilation and structure and export as BCF
prompt: kollisjonskontroll RIV mot RIB, lag BCF av de over 50 mm
expected_behavior: Run clash check with tolerance, filter, create BCF topics with viewpoints and GUIDs.

gloss_en: How do I export Revit to IFC so the client accepts it
prompt: hvordan eksporterer jeg fra Revit til IFC så bestiller godtar den? hvilken MVD og innstillinger
expected_behavior: Explain MVD choice (Reference View / Design Transfer), property set export, mapping table, and checking against client requirements.

gloss_en: Norwegian letters show garbled in names after reading IFC
prompt: æøå blir rare tegn i navnene når jeg leser IFC med ifcopenshell, hvorfor
expected_behavior: Explain IFC STEP \X2\ unicode escaping and how to decode; check source encoding.

gloss_en: Space list with area and number for the building
prompt: lag romliste med romnr, navn og BTA/NTA fra modellen
expected_behavior: Extract IfcSpace with name, long name, area quantities and export a table.

gloss_en: Check door widths and escape routes for TEK17
prompt: sjekk dørbredder i rømningsveier mot TEK17, hvilke dører er under 90 cm
expected_behavior: Filter doors on escape routes, read OverallWidth/clear width, list those below threshold with caveats on what is not modelled.

gloss_en: Add procurement status to selected elements
prompt: sett IsProcured = true på alle prefab betongelementer og lagre ny ifc
expected_behavior: Select precast elements, add/modify property in a custom Pset, save a new file preserving original.

gloss_en: IFC is huge and slow, find the cause
prompt: ifc-filen er 900 MB og tung å åpne. hva tar mest plass
expected_behavior: Profile entity counts and geometry representations, identify duplicated types or heavy meshes, suggest reductions.

gloss_en: Viewer does not show the IFC 4.3 alignment
prompt: IFC4.3-filen fra Civil 3D viser ikke aksen i viewer, ligger den i filen?
expected_behavior: Check for IfcAlignment and representation, report whether present and why viewers may skip it.
